CheckTitle: ECR registries with no lifecycle policy configured
Description: ECR registries found without a lifecycle policy configured. A lifecycle policy defines rules for the retention and removal of images in the repository, assisting in the management of storage costs and resources associated with outdated or unused images.
Risk: The ECR registries are at risk of accumulating unnecessary images, increased storage costs, as well as potential difficulties in managing the repository and security issues that may remain unattended.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure ECR registries have a lifecycle policy configured.
